title: Modification of polyamide 6 fibers with water-glass in the bath method
authors: Andrzej Gawłowski; Janusz Fabia; Czesław Ślusarczyk; Anna Brzozowska-Stanuch; Tadeusz Graczyk; Jarosław Janicki
source_version: Original published seven-page journal PDF in Biblioteka Nauki repository
composition: Commercial Stilon S.A. PA6 multifilament, source specification 21 tex f16 t0; classically melt-formed, stretched and thermally stabilized before this study, with original production conditions unreported.
TGA_specimen_preparation: Identified PA6 multifilament fiber state; TGA sample mass, pan, cutting or grinding, extra conditioning and replicate count not specified. Method states air at 40 cm³/min and 20 deg/min from 30 to 720 °C; Figure 3 caption independently assigns air.
LOI_method: PN–ISO 4589; own measured minimum oxygen percentage in oxygen/nitrogen mixture supporting ignition and sustained burning
LOI_specimen_preparation: Corresponding modified or standard PA6 multifilament fibers; LOI instrument, specimen geometry, conditioning, replicate count and uncertainty not specified.
source_numeric_evidence_description: Exact numerical labels printed on original Figure 3 DTG inset, visually verified against curve colors and caption; no graph-coordinate estimation. Treated LOI from Table 1 and control LOI explicit results prose on p 863.
TG_locator: Figure 3, p 864, exact printed 540.9/549.1 °C labels at char-oxidation DTG peaks; same-page TGA prose defines maximum as highest burning rate of carbonization products
conditions_locator: Experimental p 862: preparation and separate LOI/TGA methods; source fiber processing context p 865
source_location: Complete original pp 861–867, all methods, Tables 1–4, Figures 1–5, conclusion and all references. PDF pixels pp 862–864 inspected for preparation, LOI and exact Figure 3 annotations.
source_peak_definition: The accepted temperature is the later air DTG peak for burning/oxidation of carbonization products after the principal PA6 decomposition peak. It is stored as Tmax2_C to preserve that sequence; the first decomposition peak is not numerically extracted.
limitations: Two air conditions only, subject to independent exact-hash source QA. Figure 3 directly prints the accepted temperatures; they are later char-oxidation peaks, not initial decomposition, T5, onset, or the global peak. Figure 3 also prints ignition-related temperatures 527.9/532.9 °C, retained raw and not relabelled general Tonset. Figure 2 is a separate nitrogen experiment; the own methods assign the stated 20 deg/min and 40 cm³/min to air, so nitrogen ramp/flow are not transferred and all nitrogen pairs stay held. The approximate nitrogen maximum near 460 °C, generic 459.5 °C annotation without clear individual-series assignment, and relative 0.5% residue difference are not canonical values. DSC melting temperatures, enthalpies and crystallinity are not TG. The 16 WG loading/temperature LOIs do not imply additional TG states. Methods say WG percentage calculated per fiber weight while Table 1 calls it bath wt%; both source descriptions retained and no retained add-on or bath mass fraction is computed. The specified detergent wash is part of finishing before assays, not an extra durability series. Drying after that wash is unreported. The 50 ruptures, 2% random error and normal-climate standard belong to mechanical testing only. Source says article material was presented at the December 2016 X-Ray Investigations of Polymer Structure conference; any later separate proceedings extraction needs a future reuse check. Related PET water-glass paper DOI 10.1007/s10973-016-5498-3 concerns another polymer and no conditions or numbers are borrowed.
washing_state: Unmodified as-supplied fiber control; no treatment or durability wash assigned
treatment_method: Use commercial PA6 multifilament 21 tex f16 t0 from Stilon S.A. as the unmodified standard, separately from the water-only 120 °C blank-bath comparator.
LOI_locator: Research on effectiveness by LOI method, p 863, explicit unmodified value 24.2%; water-only comparator separately has unchanged LOI
pairing_evidence: Figure 3 caption and color-coded labels identify PA6 stand., with later air DTG peak 540.9 °C. The corresponding source LOI is 24.2%, identified in Research on effectiveness by LOI method, p 863, explicit unmodified value 24.2%; water-only comparator separately has unchanged LOI. Source methods and captions consistently refer to the same PA6 multifilament state.

sample_state: PA6 modified with source-labelled 5% water-glass at 120 °C, after prescribed finishing wash
washing_state: Post-modification wash with 5 g/dm³ Pretepon G at 60 °C for 30 min; no additional durability washing
treatment_chemistry: Commercial sodium water-glass, CAS 1344-09-8, Rudniki S.A.; NNO dispersant; Pretepon G detergent
treatment_method: Treat in Ahiba Turbomat at liquor ratio 1:50, 120 °C for 1 h, preparative heating rate 2.5 deg/min. Apply source-labelled 5% sodium water-glass calculated per fiber weight in methods; add 1.5 g/dm³ NNO nonionic dispersant. Then wash with 5 g/dm³ Pretepon G detergent at 60 °C for 30 min. Post-wash drying conditions not reported.
source_WG_percentage_basis_raw: 5% calculated per fiber weight in Experimental; Table 1 header Content of WG in bath, wt %. No conversion or retained add-on inferred.
pairing_evidence: Figure 3 caption and color-coded labels identify PA6+5%WG, 120 °C, with later air DTG peak 549.1 °C. The corresponding source LOI is 27.5%, identified in Table 1, p 863, 120 °C / 5% cell. Source methods and captions consistently refer to the same PA6 multifilament state.
